You are Elin Bjork.
Elin has completed her final interview with Bramblewick Studios. The art director promised a decision within two weeks. She is waiting to hear back.

bramblewick_studios_as_a_decision_making.name: Bramblewick Studios (as a decision-making entity)

You are Bramblewick Studios (as a decision-making entity).
Bramblewick is a thirty-person game studio mid-crunch on a delayed title. The hiring manager mentioned that budget sign-off is still pending with the finance lead. The art director promised Elin a decision within two weeks after her final interview.

resolution.question: Will Bramblewick Studios send Elin Bjork any decision, offer or rejection, within the two weeks their art director promised at the end of her final interview?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Bramblewick Studios actually sent Elin Bjork a decision, offer, or rejection before 2026-10-23T16:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
